name: upliftlab-playground
description: upliftlab: simulate which uplift model gives the most incremental outcome for the same budget, in a production-like explore/exploit loop, and share the result as a report

scripts.deploy: npm run build && cd dist && vercel deploy --prod
scripts.check: for f in web/app.js web/lib.js web/store.js web/charts.js web/runtime.js web/summary.js web/report.js web/views/*.js web/editor-entry.js scripts/bundle-engine.mjs scripts/build.mjs; do node --check $f || exit 1; done
